terbaru.judul: Artificial life of an active droplets system: a quantitative lifecycle analysis
terbaru.pelajaran: The study of synthetic active matter systems holds the promise for designing smart materials and devices with emergent characteristics akin to those of living organisms, eventually opening the doors to the realization of artificial life.

terbaru.judul: On Improvisation and Open-Endedness: Insights for Experiential AI
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work-in-progress paper, we report insights from in-depth interviews with 6 experts in improvisation across dance, music, and contact improvisation.

terbaru.judul: Analytical Swarm Chemistry: Characterization and Analysis of Emergent Swarm Behaviors
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we introduce Analytical Swarm Chemistry, a framework that integrates concepts from engineering, agent-based and artificial life research, and chemistry.

terbaru.judul: Evolvable Chemotons: Toward the Integration of Autonomy and Evolution
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, we provide a relatively simple simulation framework for constructing artificial life (ALife) with both autonomous and evolutionary aspects by extending chemoton model.
